name: Arjun Silva
headline: Analytics and Data Engineer
summary: Analytics and data engineer who builds dependable data systems, improves reporting quality, and turns messy inputs into trusted metrics. Comfortable working across Python, SQL, Scala and R in analytical environments, and shaping platform work around strong system design and maintainability. Known for practical delivery, clear communication, and steady operational improvements.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Built analytical models and reporting workflows in Python and SQL, improving daily metric freshness by 30%.
Developed reusable transformations in Scala and R to standardize customer segmentation and reduce manual cleanup.
Partnered on system design for shared data layers, cutting duplicated logic across the team by 40%.
Produced validation checks and stakeholder-ready datasets that improved trust in monthly reporting.

roles.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built ingestion and transformation jobs with Python, pandas and dbt to support finance and operations reporting.
Managed warehouse loading in BigQuery and Snowflake, reducing failed refreshes by 25%.
Automated deployment and configuration tasks with Docker, Terraform and Git, helping the team ship changes faster.
Created shell-based maintenance scripts in Bash and used SQL to monitor data quality across critical tables.
Improved pipeline reliability by documenting recovery steps and coordinating handoffs across 3 internal teams.

projects.name: Signal Inbox
projects.description: Built a message triage prototype using Kafka and GitHub Actions to move events through a lightweight processing flow and keep validation steps consistent.
